presets.title: Day After an Event
presets.summary: Of the sessions whose PREVIOUS trading session was an event day in the named calendar, how often the session closed above its open. Adjacency is trading-calendar aware, so weekends and holidays never miscount which session came after the event. The default calendar is OPEX because it ships with the engine; any other named calendar reports zero matching sessions until its date file is present.

params.name: event
params.doc: Event calendar name as listed in the events data (e.g. OPEX, FOMC, CPI, NFP).

deltas: one parameterized preset covers the entire post-event family
holiday-aware adjacency instead of calendar-day arithmetic
open-to-close return distribution attached for the size of the after-move

presets.title: Day Before an Event
presets.summary: Of the sessions whose NEXT trading session is an event day in the named calendar, how often the session closed above its open. 'Next' is trading-calendar aware: a Thursday counts as the day before a Monday event when Friday is a holiday: not naive date arithmetic. The default calendar is OPEX because it ships with the engine; point the parameter at FOMC, CPI, NFP, or any calendar file you add, and the preset reports zero matching sessions until that file is present.

params.name: event
params.doc: Event calendar name as listed in the events data (e.g. OPEX, FOMC, CPI, NFP).

deltas: one parameterized preset covers the entire pre-event family
holiday-aware adjacency instead of calendar-day arithmetic
user-supplied event files (earnings, expiries, your own day tags) work identically

presets.title: Green Rate by Weekday
presets.summary: The share of sessions closing above their open, split by weekday. Each row's denominator is every complete session on that weekday in your data; the numerator is the green ones. Weekday folklore is abundant and mostly noise: the per-row intervals and the stability split are the test, and the attached open-to-close return distribution shows whether a 'strong day' is a rate effect or a size effect.
deltas: per-weekday N and 95% CI instead of five bare percentages
return distribution alongside the rate separates frequency from magnitude
condition the whole split on anything: gaps, events, volatility regime

presets.title: Doji Follow-Through
presets.summary: Of the sessions that closed as a session-level doji: close within 10% of the session range from the open: how often the NEXT session closed green. The denominator is doji sessions with a next session on record; the numerator is the ones followed by a green close. A doji is an indecision flag, so the informative comparison is against the unconditional next-session green rate: a doji that changes nothing is itself a finding.
deltas: a stated, reproducible doji definition instead of an eyeballed one
next-session return distribution attached alongside the rate
compose with gap state or weekday to test the pattern in context

presets.title: Bearish Engulfing Follow-Through
presets.summary: Of the sessions whose red body engulfed the prior green session's body: a session-level bearish engulfing candle: how often the NEXT session closed green. The denominator is engulfing sessions with a next session on record; the numerator is the ones followed by a green close, so a LOW estimate is what the pattern's usual story predicts. Rare patterns mean small N: the guards and intervals are part of the answer, not decoration.
deltas: the exact mirror of engulfing-bull, on one definition, so the asymmetry is measurable
minimum-N guards and CIs keep rare-pattern statistics honest
compose with trend or streak conditions to test the context the textbooks assume

presets.title: Bullish Engulfing Follow-Through
presets.summary: Of the sessions whose green body engulfed the prior red session's body: a session-level bullish engulfing candle: how often the NEXT session closed green. The denominator is engulfing sessions with a next session on record; the numerator is the ones followed by a green close. Session-level engulfings are much rarer than intraday ones: expect small N, and let the guards, not the point estimate, set the tone when the sample is thin.
deltas: an explicit engulfing definition (body engulfs prior red body) instead of chart-by-chart judgment
minimum-N guards and CIs keep rare-pattern statistics honest
next-session return distribution attached alongside the rate
